title: London-based Uforce, which makes unmanned air, sea, and land vehicles, raised $700M co-led by the UK National Wealth Fund and Valor Equity at a $6B valuation (Yazhou Sun/Bloomberg)
summary: Yazhou Sun / Bloomberg: London-based Uforce, which makes unmanned air, sea, and land vehicles, raised $700M co-led by the UK National Wealth Fund and Valor Equity at a $6B valuation — The UK National Wealth Fund made its largest defense investment as part of a $700 million financing round for Uforce, a drone startup initially formed in Ukraine.
